events.facility_name: Juaymah NGL facility / LPG export terminal
events.summary: Aramco said damage at Juaymah on 23 February 2026 halted LPG exports from the site, and declared force majeure on shipments.
events.effect: LPG export loadings from Juaymah halted; force majeure declared.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 2: operator-confirmed suspension of energy (LPG) export loadings.

events.summary: The energy ministry reported on 9 April 2026 that an earlier attack on the Khurais facility cut its production capacity by about 300,000 b/d. The attack date was not given and may precede April.
events.effect: Production capacity reduced by about 300,000 b/d (ministry: "أدى إلى انخفاض إنتاجه بمقدار 300 ألف برميل يوميًا من طاقته الإنتاجية").
events.threshold_basis: Clause 7: official statement of production curtailed by a stated material volume.

capacity_affected.source_says: Energy ministry source via SPA, 9 Apr 2026: an earlier attack on Khurais reduced its output by 300,000 b/d of its production capacity.
